opening: I am writing to apply for the Forward Deployed Engineer role at SolveAI. Your opening line is the whole reason I am applying: most enterprise problems never get solved because the person who understands the problem and the person who can build the fix are never the same person. Closing that gap in person, by sitting with the people closest to the problem and shipping something in days rather than months, is the work I have been doing for three years, and your note that you are equally interested in engineers who want to make the jump into this role is what made me write rather than filter myself out.
role_specific: My daily engineering workflow revolves around the exact requirements outlined in your role: I utilize prompt chaining, RAG architectures, and advanced workflow orchestration tools (such as n8n) to connect external APIs with foundational models like OpenAI and Anthropic's Claude, and I build in TypeScript, Next.JS, React, Python and Laravel depending on what the environment already runs. Adaptability is not a claim I have to make abstractly: the freelance work for UltraStrategy, Get2Germany and Clubee each came with someone else's stack and a problem rather than a spec, and at FlowSpace I took over a system I had not written, debugged it, and carried it through a migration while it scaled from 2,000 to over 4,500 active users. I am also comfortable with the travel this role involves. Being straight about it: I have around three years of experience rather than a long enterprise track record, and I would need a UK work visa, which I mention now rather than later.
closing: I would be glad to talk about an enterprise problem you have taken from first conversation to something running.
